title: Instrument Sound Parade
hook: Find the sound source before the instrument family.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: polished 3D music-room storybook, one clear instrument or symbol per target; visual identity: Instrument Sound Parade

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child tracing where sound begins
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: mechanism-neutral recall -> target -> safe air gesture
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn Instrument Sound Parade into a sound-source parade: vibrating string, air column, reed, membrane, metal/wood body, and notation are distinguished so the listener hears mechanisms rather than a generic 'instrument sound'.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child asks what is vibrating before naming the family; Quarter Note and Instrument are category/symbol exceptions, not forced into an instrument mechanism.
